author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
An artistic pilot has "painted" a mural of GTA 6 in the sky. Benjamin McDaniel flew his Cessna across the Arkansas sky and used this flightpath to paint the image. It's not his first one; McDaniel has done the Mona Lisa, the dragon logo from Skyrim, and others. You can also request art from his website at thepilotpicasso.com. In other news, Sony has updated its list of perks for UK PlayStation Plus users, and gamers are pretty underwhelmed. The perks, such as a YouTube Premium account, Audible membership, and more, are just trials which expire after a set time limit. And we’re riding Mine Cart Madness inside Super Nintendo World with The Ride Guys at Universal Epic Universe at Universal Orlando Resort.

Presented by Universal Orlando Resort, and its newest theme park, Universal Epic Universe.

#IGN #Gaming #GTA6
title: Pilot "Paints" Impressive GTA 6 Mural In the Sky - IGN Daily Fix

The Gallerist is produced by Sophie Mas, Ash Sarohia, Natalie Portman, Jonathan King, Tom McCarthy, Rae Baron, and Zola Elgart Glassman. It is written by James Pedersen and Cathy Yan.

author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Sony has finally revealed sales numbers for Marvel's Wolverine, and while it's already a million-seller, it's still well behind Insomniac's Spider-Man 2 over the same time period of two months. Still, software sales were strong despite slower PS5 console sales. But that could change with the launch of GTA 6 in a couple of weeks. Speaking of sales figures, Nintendo has reported slower Switch 2 sales, but have not updated their financial outlook. Nintendo still expects to sell around 16 million Switch 2 units by the end of March 2027, and the console is still outpacing Year 2 sales of the Switch 1. The launch of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake should also give console sales a shot in the arm this holiday. And a peek at the five immersive worlds of the all-new Universal Epic Universe, and one of its featured attractions – Stardust Racers, all at Universal Orlando Resort. This is your Daily Fix.
title: Sony Reveals Wolverine Sales Figures, Updates Financial Forecast - IGN Daily Fix
